text:
Maya Singh: Quick request  need a compact design package for the benchmark launch next week. Scope: hero banner (1600x400), social tiles (1:1 and 16:9), story-sized vertical (9:16), email header (600x200), and a single-slide "flowmap" that visualizes webinar -> lead routing -> demo -> trial with clear labels for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Accessibility-first: reduced-motion variants + dark-mode exports. Deadline: Thu EOD.

Ethan Brooks: On it. Do you want a motion-first hero (Lottie) or keep motion optional? Also confirm the hero copy: short hook + 1-line value prop + CTA?

Maya Singh: Motion optional. Provide a Lottie for web and a static PNG for email. Copy structure yes: 1-line hook, 1-line value, 1 CTA. I'll post copy in a comment.

Zara Ibrahim: Flowmap ask: sales wants optional stat callouts (median latency / $ per 1k tokens). Please make them a toggle layer in the SVG. Also ask: label arrows with "latency" and "unit cost".

Brand Review: Reminder: use palette-v3 tokens only. Headline font = Inter Display. Body = Inter. No neon accent colors. Body text contrast >= 4.5:1. Provide alt text for each asset.

Ethan Brooks: Will start comps tonight. ETA first pass Wed 10am PT. I'll include dark-mode layers and a reduced-motion PNG for the hero. Will post Figma link when ready.

Maya Singh: Copy (short): "Inference that scales, costs that don't." Value line: "Real-world latency vs cost tradeoffs — see benchmarks & routing options." CTAs: "Register" / "See benchmark" / "Request demo".

Zara Ibrahim: For export specs: please include filenames like: hero-web-1600x400-v1.png, social-1x1-1200x1200-v1.png, flowmap-600x360-v1.svg and a manifest JSON listing sizes and alt text.

DesignOps Bot: Design slot booked for Ethan Tue 2pm PT. If you need rush, request a swap. I'll also create a checklist for deliverables.

Ethan Brooks: Quick question on social animation: brand allows up to 6s loop, no blink/strobe. Confirmed?

Brand Review: Confirmed. Avoid rapid contrast flashes. Also provide accessible captions for animated versions.

Maya Singh: Good. Also make sure the flowmap is modular (separate Hosted/Dedicated/Private icons) so sales can recolor or hide nodes.

Ethan Brooks: Noted. I'll make components and include a PDF export for decks. ETA Wed 10am PT for initial pass + Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-commkit

DesignOps Bot: Reminder scheduled Thu 9am PT for handoff QA and brand sweep.

Maya Singh: Thanks all  if anything blocks accessibility or brand compliance, flag ASAP. Otherwise locking Thu EOD. :rocket:
